meta.name: Triage scam messages and alert family with Claude and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## AI Safety Assistant

### How it works

This workflow analyzes suspicious calls, WhatsApp messages, and emails using AI to detect scams, explain risks simply, suggest safe actions, alert trusted family members about high-risk fraud, and maintain a history of suspicious activity.

### Setup steps

- Configure the webhook endpoint and ensure the calling app sends the expected message text, channel, sender, and claimed identity fields.
- Add Anthropic credentials for both AI agent model nodes and verify the prompts/model settings match your safety-assistant use case.
- Configure Google Sheets API access for the scam tracker request, including the target spreadsheet ID, range, and authorization credentials.
- Configure SendGrid API credentials, sender details, and family alert recipient addresses for the notification request.
- Review the JavaScript nodes for expected input/output field names so the scoring, parsing, logging, and response payloads align.

### Customization

Adjust heuristic keywords, AI prompts, composite risk scoring weights, family-alert thresholds, Google Sheets columns, and response wording to match the audience and escalation policy.

## Receive message context

Webhook entry cluster that receives the suspicious message, prepares standard context fields, and extracts initial heuristic risk signals before AI analysis.

## Analyze fraud indicators

Runs the first AI fraud-analysis pass after a wait step, using the Anthropic model, then parses the AI response into structured analysis data.

## Validate and score risk

Checks whether the fraud analysis is usable, returns an insufficiency response when it is not, and otherwise calculates the composite risk score for downstream guidance.

## Generate safety guidance

Waits before the second AI step, generates safety guidance and recommendations with Anthropic, then parses the guidance and formats a log record.

## Log and decide alert

Saves the formatted scam report to the Google Sheets tracker and evaluates whether the case requires a family alert notification.

## Send high-risk alert

High-risk branch that sends a SendGrid family alert email and responds to the webhook confirming the alert was sent.


## Return normal guidance

No-alert endpoint that returns the generated guidance to the webhook when a family notification is not required.

They told me not to tell my family because it is a confidential federal investigation.' }}
